_comment: Declarative phase graph for scripts/workflow-state.sh (bd: shode-roadmap/C-A5, iter 2). Expands the iter-0/1 6-node tracer-bullet set into the real shode-house phase set named in ROADMAP-runtime-10.md SS1.1/SS1.2 and CLAUDE.md 'PEV Loop': 0-discover, 1a-spec, 1b-design, 1c-security, 2-implement, 3a-ui-check, 3b-review, 4-triage, 5-deploy, 6-operate. `conditional_phases` lists phases that may end in status=skipped (advance's <outcome> arg). `enter_requires` is a generic gate keyed by target phase name -- read by scripts/workflow-state.sh's enter_requires_check() for ANY key present here, not special-cased in code; only `2-implement` is populated because that is the one concrete example ROADMAP-runtime-10.md SS1.1 gives (phase_2.enter_requires). This is the single place phase-to-phase edges are declared (FR-102 DRY, carried over from iter0) -- no other file may hardcode a second copy. The iter>3-forces-escalated rule is intentionally NOT an edge here (see scripts/workflow-state.sh comment above the escalate branch of cmd_advance) -- it is a self-transition status assignment on whatever phase is currently active, generic across every phase without needing 10 declared self-loop rows.
